dogecoin.text:
Please, not with the Dogecoin bullshit now.

Fuck's sake, I own some Dogecoin and even I think it's ridiculous and doomed to fail. I'm ready to lose the amount of money I put into it.

Like gambling, but stupider.

Wait so Dogecoin only went up in value because Elon Musk went on SNL? I dunno, that's what I see just by looking at the timing of Dogecoin breaking records, then plummeting.

People are so fickle when it comes to their Iron Man wannabe daddy Musk.
